newsitem.title: UK: UK 97 consumer spending to grow over 4 pct - Clarke.
newsitem.headline: UK 97 consumer spending to grow over 4 pct - Clarke.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke forecast that British consumer spending would increase by three percent in 1996 and by more than four percent in 1997.

"I expect consumer spending to grow by three percent in 1996 as a whole. But it has been strengthening through the year. I expect stronger growth to continue, with consumers' expenditure rising by over four percent nect year," he said in a speech to parliament on the 1997/98 budget.
In Clarke's summer economic forecasts, released in July, consumer spending was forecast to rise by 4.25 percent in 1997.
